title: Iran's Mahan Air Suspends Turkey Flights as US Sanctions Hit Turkish Intermediary Firms
detail: Iranian carrier Mahan Air suspended all flights between Tehran and Istanbul/Ankara starting September 21, following an expanded US Treasury sanctions package announced September 8 covering 36 targets and 27 Iranian carriers. The sanctions also named three Turkey-based companies — Sky Phoenix, S Sistem and Mes Cargo — accused of helping transfer Boeing 777 aircraft to Mahan Air via the UAE and Oman and coordinating shipments, including drone components, bound for Iran, deepening the fallout from Washington's pressure campaign on Turkish firms doing business with Tehran.

media.caption: Mahan Air halts Tehran–Istanbul and Tehran–Ankara flights amid US sanctions

title: Council of Europe Gives Turkey Until October 14 to Detail Steps on Kavala's Release
detail: The Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers, meeting in Strasbourg on September 15–16, gave Turkey until October 14 to report concrete steps taken or planned toward releasing jailed philanthropist Osman Kavala, imprisoned since 2017. The request follows an August 25 European Court of Human Rights Grand Chamber ruling that Turkey must release Kavala 'at the earliest possible date' and eliminate all consequences of his conviction; the committee called the prosecution 'flagrantly unjust and politically motivated' and noted Turkey has defied three prior ECtHR judgments in the case.

media.caption: Council of Europe sets an October 14 deadline for Turkey on Osman Kavala's release
